name: Blessings and More Bakery - Mobile unit

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment: Observed mobile unit to not have signed employee reporting agreements for all food employees. All employees signed a reporting agreement during inspection.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution available for use. Sanitizer solution was made during inspection, and tested at 200 ppm Cl-.
